message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7068,"var":"ctxt","code":"xmlParseReference(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt)","note":"An attacker-controlled entity reference is encountered during parsing."},
  {"step":2,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7138,"var":"list","code":"ret = xmlCtxtParseInternalEntity(ctxt, ent->content, &list);","note":"The entity replacement text is parsed into a node list that will be reused on expansion."},
  {"step":3,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7228,"var":"list->doc","code":"if (list->doc != ent->doc) xmlSetTreeDoc(list, ent->doc);","note":"The parsed subtree is retargeted to the entity document, preserving pointers into the cached tree."},
  {"step":4,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7235,"var":"ent->owner","code":"ent->owner = 0;","note":"The entity is marked as not owning the subtree, so later expansions will copy from the cached nodes instead of transferring ownership."},
  {"step":5,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7389,"var":"cur","code":"cur = ent->children; ent->children = NULL;","note":"A later expansion detaches the cached subtree from the entity before copying it into the live document."},
  {"step":6,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlDocCopyNode","line":4462,"var":"ret","code":"ret = xmlStaticCopyNode(node, doc, NULL, extended);","note":"The detached node is duplicated into the target document through the generic copy routine."},
  {"step":7,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlStaticCopyNode","line":4282,"var":"node->ns","code":"ns = xmlSearchNs(node->doc, node, node->ns->prefix);","note":"Namespace resolution reads source-node namespace pointers during the copy."},
  {"step":8,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlStaticCopyNode","line":4286,"var":"ns->href","code":"ret->ns = xmlNewNs(root, ns->href, ns->prefix);","note":"Dereferencing the stale namespace object triggers the use-after-free sink."}
]
EOF
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.xml /workspace/candidate_trace.json
